docs.text: SSH Setup Switch HP A5500: Création du VLAN de Management (VLAN 150) en system-view: vlan 150 quit Insertion du port de choisit dans le VLAN de Management interface GigabitEthernet1/0/32 port access vlan 150 ssh server enable Adresse IP du VLAN interface Vlan-Interface 150 ip address X.X.X.X 255.255.255.0 Création des utilisateurs administrateurs du switch local-user M3Enzo authorization-attribute level 3 service-type ssh password cipher <password> quit local-user M3lucas authorization-attribute level 3 service-type ssh password cipher <password> quit Finition user-interface vty 0 15 authentication-mode scheme return save safely force
